name: timm_inference_benchmark
description: A benchmarking dataset and suite that measures inference performance (throughput, latency, and memory) of image models available in the timm (PyTorch Image Models) collection across hardware/software configurations. It enables comparisons of per-model images/sec, latency (ms), and GPU/CPU memory usage to evaluate deployment trade-offs between accuracy and runtime cost. Primarily used by practitioners to profile and optimize model inference for real-world deployments.
evaluation_method: throughput (images/sec), latency (ms per batch or per image), and memory consumption measurements
general_score_metric: throughput (images/sec) and latency (ms); model comparisons typically report both
typical_sota_score: varies widely by model and hardware (no single SOTA); reported metrics are model- and hardware-specific (e.g., lightweight models achieve high images/sec while large models have higher latency)
reputation: Practical, developer-oriented benchmark used by practitioners benchmarking timm models; useful for systems comparisons though not a widely cited academic benchmark.
